verdict.rationale: Rippling explicitly markets that 'your people and agents' live in one identity system with real-time access updates and full visibility into AI tool/OAuth usage (docs-2, docs-23), and it has a scoped Bearer-token API model (docs-22) plus a documented MCP server (probe-2). However there is no detailed documentation of concrete patterns like token vaulting, cross-app agent access flows, or dedicated agent credential lifecycle management—this is mostly marketing language rather than a technical pattern guide. Missing for 10: worked examples/docs on token vaulting, explicit agent-scoped credential issuance workflows, cross-app access control specifics for non-human identities, and independent corroboration.
